name: Strawberry – Please Don't Pick Me
title: Strawberry – Please Don't Pick Me Mug
story: This strawberry mug is for the quiet friend who would rather stay on the vine: the bookworm, the introvert, the coworker who dreads being called on in the meeting. A shy little strawberry hugs a book to its chest with rosy cheeks and a tiny smile, and its one request is written right on the mug. It makes an easy Christmas morning coffee gift or stocking stuffer for anyone who has ever hoped nobody would notice them.

The print is a red strawberry with a crown of sage green and cream leaves, pink cheeks, and a small green book held tight in both arms, standing on a few fallen leaves. PLEASE DON'T sits above it and PICK ME below in bold red slab capitals, big enough to read across a desk, on bright white glossy ceramic.

It matches our Please Don't Pick Me oversized hoodie, so the mug and the hoodie make a set for the same shy, book-loving person. Fill it with coffee, tea or cocoa and take your cup to the quiet corner of the couch. It also makes a sweet desk mug for anyone who prefers to be left alone with a good book.
joke_a: A shy strawberry hugs a little book and begs the world not to pick it: PLEASE DON'T PICK ME. The Please Don't Pick Me strawberry mug from Graphic Tees Co. is the introvert's line, plus a real strawberry joke, for the bookworm and the quiet coworker who hopes nobody calls on them.
